violations.message: RiskReport must link at least one evidence id.

input_narrative: SYNTHETIC NARRATIVE: Synthetic overnight telemetry pool reported a minor, non-recurrent ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity with no adverse patient outcome recorded. The retrospective clinician note documenting this ventricular tachycardia-adjacent irregularity was never filed, so recurrence cannot yet be ruled out from the record alone. The case is being handled at a monitoring/investigation level, not as a confirmed life-threatening event.
